jpho.2025.1.1.source_format: Official JPhO examination paper (Japanese), translated into English for this bank; the translation was checked against the page images of the original
jpho.2025.1.1.source_variant_note: Problems © JPhO (物理オリンピック日本委員会). Translated from the official Japanese paper (物理チャレンジ2025 第2チャレンジ 理論問題, 23 August 2025). The PDF contains the problems only (cover page with instructions, problem pages 1–26); the cover instructions (注意事項) contain no data and were left out. Answers are written on separate answer sheets (not part of this file). Japanese labels: none inside the figures. Typos in the Japanese text (not visible in the translation): 閉じ込めらた for 閉じ込められた (introduction), 系ではでは (Q10, doubled では), 分子間引力のよる for 分子間引力による (Q11). The cut-off distance is printed upright r_c in the running text and italic r_c in Q9, Q10 and Q12; kept as printed. Bold terms ビリアル / ビリアル定理 rendered as plain 'virial' / 'virial theorem'.

jpho.2026.1.1.source_variant_note: Problems © JPhO (物理オリンピック日本委員会). Translated from the official Japanese paper (物理チャレンジ2026 第2チャレンジ 理論問題, 19 August 2026). Printed title 第1問（75点）同期現象 — Kuramoto model. The section 3 heading 自己無撞着 (むどうちゃく) 方程式と臨界点 carries a reading aid in parentheses, which is dropped in translation. As printed: equations (4) and (5) read 'j = 1, ··· N' without a comma; Q11 uses both $T_c$ (italic c) and $T_{\mathrm{c}}$. The figure after Q6 (10 oscillators on the unit circle with a grid) is also printed on the answer sheet. The PDF (32 pages) contains the statements only (no solutions); the cover page instructions (注意事項), blank page 2 and the MEMO/blank pages 30–32 are omitted. Bold and underlined emphasis is rendered as plain text. Japanese labels inside the figures are kept as printed, with translations in square brackets.
